vol_uncrop — 3D domain op

• Data kinds: voxel → voxel

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_uncrop(part, offset, shape, fill=0.0) (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import volops; volops.vol_uncrop(part, offset, shape, fill=0.0), registry से लेना हो तो ops3d.get("vol_uncrop"))

उपयोग

crop किए गए sub-volume को वापस पूरे frame में चिपकाता है (vol_crop_domain का inverse)।

> नीचे का विस्तृत विवरण मूल text में है — सारांश और headings का अनुवाद हो चुका है।

*part* is placed at voxel *offset* (z0, y0, x0) inside a new (D, H, W) float64 volume of the given *shape*, everything else set to *fill* (the 2-D full_domain restoration, made explicit — the cropped result must land at exactly the coordinates it came from). The part must fit entirely inside *shape* at *offset*; anything else raises ValueError rather than silently clipping data. *offset* and *shape* must be whole voxel counts (a fractional value is rejected, never truncated — a silent int(1.5) -> 1 would shift the data one voxel with no warning), and *fill* must be a finite number: every operator in this module refuses NaN/Inf voxels, so a non-finite fill would produce a volume nothing downstream will accept.
